text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Good Shepherd Nuns
(Incorporation) Act 1973.

2. (1) Sister Joan Gormley, the Sister Superior of the
Good Shepherd Nuns in Malaysia and her successors in
office, shall be a body corporate by the name of "the
Sister Superior of the Good Shepherd Nuns,
Malaysia", in this Act referred to as "the
Corporation'.

(2) The Corporation may enter into contracts and
may acquire, purchase, take, hold and enjoy movable
and immovable property of every description and may
convey, transfer, assign, surrender and yield up,
charge, mortgage, demise, reassign or otherwise
dispose of, or deal with, any movable or immovable
property vested in the Corporation.

(3) The Corporation may sue and be sued in respect
of its property and otherwise in all courts of justice and
in all matters and suits.

3. (1) The Corporation shall have a common seal and
such seal may from time to time be broken, changed,
altered and made anew as to the Corporation seems fit.

(2) No deed, document or other instrument sealed
with the seal of the Corporation shall be deemed to be
duly sealed unless—

(a) such seal has been affixed in the presence of
the Sister Superior for the time being in office,
or her attorney duly authorized by a power of
attorney registered under the Powers of
Attorney Act 1949; and

(b) such deed, document or other instrument is
signed by the said Sister Superior for the time
being in office or her attorney so authorized as
aforesaid.

(3) Such signing shall be and be taken as sufficient
evidence of the due sealing of such deed, document or
other instrument.

4. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment of
any person to hold, or act in, the office of Sister
Superior of the Good Shepherd Nuns in Malaysia shall
be conclusive evidence that such person was duly
authorized and appointed.

5. All movable and immovable property situated in
Malaysia heretofore held for and by, conveyed,
assigned, granted, leased, transferred, transmitted to
or Otherwise vested in the Sister Superior of the Good
Shepherd Nuns in Malaysia is hereby vested in the
Corporation for the purposes of this Act and subject to
the rules for the time being of the Corporation.

6. Nothing in this Act shall affect the rights of the Yang
di-Pertuan Agong, the Rulers or the Yang di-Pertua
Negeri or of any body politic or corporate or of any
persons except such as are mentioned in this Act and
those claiming by, from or under them.
